resumeText:
Sana Qureshi | Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh | sana.qureshi.cti@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security), Awadh Institute of Technology, Lucknow (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.4/10

INTERNSHIP
Threat Intelligence Intern, Gomti Cyber Labs, Lucknow (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 8 weeks)
- Collected indicators of compromise from AlienVault OTX and public threat feeds for a weekly client bulletin.
- Mapped techniques from two ransomware reports to MITRE ATT&CK and summarised them in a table.
- Looked up exposed company assets on Shodan and listed open RDP ports for the analyst team.

PROJECTS
- Phishing domain watch (personal): Tracked newly registered look-alike domains of Indian banks using open source intelligence and WHOIS records.
- Traffic analysis (academic, Computer Networks course): Analysed DNS and TCP/IP traffic in Wireshark captures to spot a simulated beaconing host as part of the Computer Networks course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Computer Networks, Cryptography, Cyber Forensics, Operating Systems
- TryHackMe Cyber Threat Intelligence module; Cisco Introduction to Cybersecurity

SKILLS
Threat intelligence, OSINT, MITRE ATT&CK, Splunk (basics), Wireshark, Shodan, Linux basics

ACTIVITIES
- Published a weekly threat brief for the college cyber club with 300 readers
- Ranked 42nd of 600 teams in a national student CTF
